title: Utility
description: Handy everyday commands for finding information and checking that Damselette is awake. Anyone can use them.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Sends a link to the documentation, where every command, permission and feature is explained in detail. It also works in direct messages with Damselette.

commands.name: ping
commands.summary: Check how quickly Damselette is responding.
commands.description: Shows Damselette's current WebSocket latency to Discord in milliseconds. If it ever feels slow, this is the first thing to check. It also works in direct messages.

commands.name: avatar
commands.summary: Show a user's avatar in full size.
commands.description: Displays a user's profile picture at high resolution. Leave the user out to see your own. It also works in direct messages.

options.name: user
options.description: The user whose avatar you want. Defaults to you.

commands.name: userinfo
commands.description: Displays a user's ID, when their account was created and, if they are in the server, when they joined and which roles they have.

options.name: user
options.description: The user to look up. Defaults to you.

notes: The role list shows up to 15 roles, highest first.

commands.name: serverinfo
commands.summary: Show an overview of the current server.
commands.description: Displays the server's icon and name, owner, member count, creation date, number of channels and roles, and boost count.
